name: Domino Poker
description: Domino Poker is a draw-and-compare domino game where players form the strongest poker-style tile pattern.

overview.description: Domino Poker is a draw-and-compare domino game where players form the strongest poker-style tile pattern.

history.origins: Domino Poker emerged as a house-game adaptation of card poker concepts using pip combinations instead of card suits and ranks.
timeline: 20th century: tile-based poker variants appear in social domino circles.
Modern era: rules documented in hobby collections and online game references.
history.cultural: Commonly used in mixed game nights as a fast gambling-style domino variant.
history.evolution: Card hand names were mapped to domino pairings and pip patterns, producing variant ranking tables.

setup.dealing: Each player is dealt a starting hand; remaining tiles form boneyard for draw phases.

rules.objective: Build the highest-ranking domino poker hand by draw and replacement, then win at showdown.
rules.gameplay: Players receive starting tiles, then perform draw/discard rounds to improve combinations. After final draw, all active players reveal hands and compare according to agreed domino poker ranking table.
keyRules: Hand rankings are defined by domino-specific combination table.
Draws come from the boneyard while tiles remain.
Final comparison resolves winner by ranking then tie-break pips.
All players reveal simultaneously at showdown.

strategy.basic: Keep core pair structures and replace low-value outliers.
strategy.intermediate: Track visible discards to estimate remaining outs.
strategy.advanced: Optimize draw count by expected upgrade value under remaining boneyard state.
tips: Avoid breaking a near-made high pattern for speculative draws.
Late-round conservative holds often outperform high-variance redraws.

variations.name: Single Draw
variations.description: Only one draw round before showdown.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Single-draw variant differs only in round count; no engine overrides documented in sources.

scoring.description: Winning hand is determined by domino poker ranking at showdown.
scoring.winCondition: Highest-ranked revealed hand wins the round.

synthesis.shortDescription: A draw-and-replace domino hand game with poker-style ranking comparison.

hero.subtitle: Draw and Showdown Tiles
hero.tagline: Shape the strongest hand before the reveal.
